name: ETA Group Berhad
overview: ETA Group Berhad 今年推进业务多元化，拟新增物业与建筑业务，并通过子公司 ETA Development 以 RM16.50 million 收购土地及厂房；同时拟出售 PT Rex Canning 38% 股权和 Rex Foods 100% 股权，退出部分业务。建筑相关公司 ETA D&B 签订总值 RM66.69 million 的设计与建造合约，并分包 RM63.51 million 给 ETA World。
overview_en: ETA Group Berhad pursued business diversification this year, proposing to include property and construction in its business, and via subsidiary ETA Development acquiring land and a factory building for RM16.50 million; it also proposed to dispose of 38% of PT Rex Canning and 100% of Rex Foods, exiting certain businesses. Construction-related ETA D&B entered into design-and-build contracts worth RM66.69 million and subcontracted RM63.51 million to ETA World.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年推进业务多元化至物业与建筑，并拟出售部分子公司股权。
segments.note_en: This year the group pursued diversification into property and construction and proposed disposal of certain subsidiary stakes.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述 RM16.50 million 收购已完成，余额付款及分摊支出已结清。
actions.text_en: The RM16.50 million acquisition was completed with balance purchase price and apportioned outgoings fully settled.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟出售 PT Rex Canning 38% 股权（RM14,043,090）及 Rex Foods 100% 股权（RM8,683,021），以现金支付。
actions.text_en: Proposed disposal of 38% equity interest in PT Rex Canning for RM14,043,090 and 100% equity interest in Rex Foods for RM8,683,021, satisfied in cash.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: ETA D&B 签订三份设计与建造合约总值 RM66,689,792.60，并分包给 ETA World 总值 RM63,514,088.18，涉及 Selangor 州 Klang 县 Mukim Kapar 的三项工业发展项目。
actions.text_en: ETA D&B entered into three design-and-build contracts worth RM66,689,792.60 and subcontracted to ETA World for RM63,514,088.18 for three industrial developments in Mukim Kapar, Daerah Klang, Selangor.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 ETA Development 以 RM16.50 million 收购一幅永久地契土地连同5层办公楼/厂房及地下停车场。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary ETA Development acquired freehold land with a 5-storey office/factory building and basement carpark for RM16.50 million.

model_changes.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE FOLLOWING:- PART A - PROPOSED DIVERSIFICATION OF THE EXISTING BUSINESS OF ETA GROUP BERHAD ("ETA
model_changes.text_en: Proposed diversification into property and construction business, adding a new business line.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 拟出售 PT Rex Canning 38% 股权及 Rex Foods 100% 股权，退出该等业务。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed disposal of 38% equity interest in PT Rex Canning and 100% equity interest in Rex Foods, exiting these businesses.
